posts.title: Simplicity 1611 (2013) view B, dress with overlay
posts.description: Simplicity 1611 (2013) is a woven gentle-a-line shift-style dress pattern, with variations. It's on the boxy, and flowy, side, rather than bodycon. With a centre-back lapped zipper. View B uses the basic short dress, but with a full length dress over the top of it. ( Details ) Finished, front Photo by chebe comments

posts.title: Seamwork Rory knit top
posts.description: Seamwork's Rory is a short knit tshirt-style top, with grown-on sleeves, that is gathered into a waistband. It is minimal, with front, back, neckband, and waistband tie, pieces. No extra parts required, just fabric and thread. ( Details ) Finished, front Photo by chebe comments

posts.title: Seamwork Christina skirt, v.2
posts.description: Seamwork's Christina is a quirky take on a simple pencil skirt. You remember the v.1 I did in denim? This time I'll be trying the bonus pattern variation. ( Details ) Finished, front Photo by chebe comments
